The function picks one candidate car ebx per side: by byte +0xfe bits 6/4 of esi it reads the dword globals [0x6043dc]/[0x6043d8] (first pass) and [0x604278]/[0x604274] (second pass), otherwise [ecx+0x6041a4] / [ecx+0x604224] with ecx = movsx word +0xea (the car's AI state: 0, +-8, +-0x10, 0x18, 0x20, i.e. byte offsets -0x10..0x20 into two per-state car-pointer tables; cars_0042dd4b, last among the car layouts, draws exactly these states). Each ebx goes to 0x42dc79 ('or ebx,ebx; je' then 'cmp bp,[ebx+0x68]') and to 'or ebx,ebx; je; cmp ebx,[0x604280]; je; cmp bp,[ebx+0x68]' at 0x42e7f5, then +0x9c/+0xe2 and 0x40dc8a/0x42a792 on the pair: so every source is null or a car record of the 22-car array 0x66fef0 (zero in the image; the fuzzed dwords were wild and faulted at 0x42dc93/0x42e801, ~half the cases). They draw null in 3/25 and a car 0..21 otherwise; the two tables are drawn over 0x604194..0x6041c4 and 0x604214..0x604244 (13 dwords each, the full span the state offsets reach; 0x43052f reads the same lists at 0x60419c/0x6041a4/0x6041ac). [0x623e04] is the word 0x42a792's cap 0x623e08 is reset to before each scoring call (copied, compared only): 0x7fff mostly plus small/zero/negative; [0x603b00] is the lap-distance window added to +0x68 for the 0x42e191 pass (bp, compared with car +0x68 words of +-0x1000): +-0x40. The scoring loop's 0x42a792 pair inputs of all 22 cars (left at their static zero by the car composition): dword +0x98 (0x426031 indexes 0x63a194 by |x>>22| <= 512: any i32), speed word +0x9a and the distance words +0xd0/+0xd2 drawn from car_0042a792's round-value lists (a subset of the random words the 0x42dd4b family accepts), so its zero-low-word negate and 'cmp eax,0x1000' paths occur.
